brief:
Formula One champion Lewis Hamilton toured the Gaza border area in North Sinai, where Egyptian Governor Khaled Megawer briefed him on aid operations, Al Jazeera English reported. The British driver visited the Rafah crossing, Egypt's main humanitarian corridor into Gaza.

Megawer outlined Egypt's coordination of relief efforts flowing through the crossing point. Hamilton's presence at the border drew international attention to Gaza's humanitarian situation.
dek: North Sinai Governor Khaled Megawer briefs the British driver on Egypt-coordinated aid efforts through Rafah crossing.
title: Lewis Hamilton visits Gaza border as Egypt coordinates aid
